title: Toybox After Hours: Closing Shift
about: A tiny 3D toy-store cleanup sim where every misplaced plushie, dragon, robot, board game, and block set belongs in the right wall, bin, pegboard, shelf, or table before sunrise. Some toys are broken into separate pieces and must be fixed at the repair bench before they can go back on display. Completed displays earn tool credits for shop equipment like the scanner.

controls.desc: Move through the shop in first person
Look around, including up and down
Lock mouse look; Tab or Esc releases it
Pick up, shelf, place on the bench, or place on the floor
Open or close the shop tools screen
